title: Encoding initial configurations
statement: Let $A$ be a finite alphabet with decidable equality, let $P$ be a finite Turing machine over $A$, let $e$ embed the Booleans into $A$, and let $x$ be a binary word. Encoding the initial configuration of $P$ on the word obtained by applying $e$ to each bit of $x$ gives exactly the initial configuration of the transverse binary realization of $P$ on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite Turing machine over $A$
replaced:
Let $P$ be a machine over a finite alphabet $A$, $e$ an embedding of the Booleans
into $A$, and $x$ a binary word. Encoding the initial configuration of $P$ on the
symbolwise embedding of $x$ yields exactly the initial configuration of the
transverse binary realization of $P$ on $x$.
